title: VERIDIAN Prompt Metadata (compliance.prompt_versions.metadata)
description: VERIDIAN_Architecture_v2.0.docx section 2.6 ("Prompt Metadata Schema, 200+ Fields") realized at minimum-viable field depth, per this phase's own CONSTRAINTS -- same precedent as AUDITOR_ENGINE_FINDING_RECORD_SCHEMA_2026-07-24.schema.json (claude-control) for a document-derived schema built to real, load-bearing depth rather than the document's full field count verbatim. Covers all 18 categories the document names; each category carries a handful of its 'Key Examples' fields (the document's own column), not its full 10-25+ field count -- individual implementations may extend a category's properties later without a migration, since this schema targets a `jsonb` column (compliance.prompt_versions.metadata, drizzle/0262) with additionalProperties left open per-category for exactly that reason. Every field on every prompt_versions row is optional (default {}) -- this schema describes the shape when a category IS populated, not a requirement that every version populate every category.

functional.description: Core identification and classification. Document category 'Functional', 25+ fields -- minimum-viable subset below.

ui.description: Discovery and presentation. Document category 'UI', 15+ fields.

workflow.description: Orchestration and sequencing. Document category 'Workflow', 15+ fields.

business.description: Business alignment and accountability. Document category 'Business', 15+ fields.

validation.description: Quality assurance and testing. Document category 'Validation', 15+ fields. Distinct from the `testing` category below: this is what a version REQUIRES to be considered valid; `testing` is what has ACTUALLY been run against it.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the rendered output must conform to, when the template demands strict-JSON output (mirrors the ai_router/orchestrate.* convention prompt-os-resolver.ts already documents)

test_cases.description: prompt_eval_cases.id references (compliance.prompt_eval_cases, Wave 94) -- not duplicated test data, just links

analytics.description: Performance monitoring and optimization. Document category 'Analytics', 20+ fields. Read-only/derived -- a real service should compute and write these, never accept them verbatim from an untrusted caller.

security.description: Access control and compliance. Document category 'Security', 15+ fields. Enforcement of these (e.g. an actual injection-risk gate) is phase_4 (Defense-in-Depth) scope -- this category just gives that phase somewhere real to read/write.

performance.description: Execution planning and budgeting. Document category 'Performance', 15+ fields.

ai.description: Model selection and parameterization. Document category 'AI', 20+ fields.

browser.description: Browser capability matching. Document category 'Browser', 15+ fields -- relevant once phase_5 (Browser Execution Tiers) exists; this category has no live reader yet, same honest-limitation posture as every other not-yet-wired category here.

cache.description: Cache strategy and invalidation. Document category 'Cache', 10+ fields.

gateway.description: API gateway integration. Document category 'Gateway', 10+ fields. `gateway_id` should reference a real G01-G10 id from 20_ENGINES_10_GATEWAYS_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml (claude-control) once a category consumer exists.

version.description: Version management and history. Document category 'Version', 15+ fields. The document's own `version`/`rollback_version` fields are real, first-class DB columns here (major/minor/patch, rolled_back_from_version_id -- drizzle/0262), not metadata -- this category only carries the softer descriptive fields.

diff_hash.description: sha256 of `content`, for cheap equality checks before running a full diffPromptVersions() call

execution.description: Runtime behavior tracking. Document category 'Execution', 15+ fields. Overlaps `analytics` deliberately per the document's own two categories -- analytics is latency/hit-rate focused, execution is outcome/cost focused.

audit.description: Governance and compliance audit. Document category 'Audit', 15+ fields. `approved_by`/`approval_chain` describe the approval-GATE state phase_3 (governance-lifecycle-state-machine's enforcement half) will read/write -- this phase only provides the storage shape.

learning.description: Continuous improvement signals. Document category 'Learning', 10+ fields. Natural future integration point for loop_improvements (compliance.loop_improvements, Wave 5) once a phase wires it.

testing.description: Quality assurance metrics. Document category 'Testing', 15+ fields. `test_coverage`/`regression_status` should be derived from real prompt_eval_runs rows (compliance.prompt_eval_runs, Wave 94) once a phase wires that aggregation -- never hand-entered.
